name: molecule_id
description: Stable identifier of the row: mol- followed by 32 hexadecimal characters. Unique within a store.

name: molecule_key
description: Cross-file join key: a 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of the movie hash and the quantized donor position. An analysis-only import hashes its source instead. Not unique.

name: movie_id
description: Identifier of the source /movies row. Empty in an analysis-only project, which has no movie.

name: source_filename
description: Name of the file the row's provenance was parsed from: the movie, or the imported SMD or .txt file.

name: condition_id
description: Condition key.

name: condition_id_provisional
description: Provisional condition key parsed from the file name at extraction, kept unchanged after a later re-key.

name: curation_label
description: Curation decision as text: accept, uncurated or reject.

name: category
description: Free-text category, editable per condition.

name: quality_class
description: Read-only machine-learning quality score. Its range is not defined. Blank in every export the current build writes.

name: aperture_id
description: Index into the aperture registry. Always 0, a placeholder; it does not describe the aperture geometry.

name: alpha
description: Donor-to-acceptor leakage factor alpha. Blank until the correction step estimates it.

name: gamma
description: Detection-correction factor gamma. Blank until it is estimated.

name: delta
description: Direct-excitation factor delta. 0.0 and not used in two-colour data.

name: correction_method
description: Correction applied to the molecule: empty (none yet), corrected, manual, apparent-E (corrections unavailable) or apparent-E (user toggle).

name: correction_confidence
description: Provenance flag, not a statistical interval: 1.0 when a photophysical correction was applied, 0.0 when the molecule fell back to apparent E.

name: donor_bleach_frame
description: Zero-based absolute frame where the donor bleaches. -1 when not detected; equal to frame_end when the donor does not bleach in the trace.

name: acceptor_bleach_frame
description: Zero-based absolute frame where the acceptor bleaches, with the same -1 and frame_end conventions.

name: frame_start
description: First frame of the molecule's valid extent, zero-based and inclusive.

name: frame_end
description: End of the molecule's valid extent, zero-based and exclusive.

name: window_start
description: First frame of the resolved analysis window, zero-based and inclusive. Equals frame_start when no window is set.

name: window_end
description: End of the resolved analysis window, zero-based and exclusive. Equals frame_end when no window is set.

name: tags
description: Free-text tags joined with commas.

name: n_finite_frames
description: Number of frames in the resolved window that have a finite apparent E.

name: mean_apparent_e
description: Mean apparent FRET efficiency A/(D+A) over the finite frames of the window. Not gamma-corrected and not clipped to [0, 1]. Blank when n_finite_frames is 0.

name: median_apparent_e
description: Median apparent FRET efficiency over the same frames. Not gamma-corrected and not clipped. Blank when n_finite_frames is 0.
